title: When the Cellar Sings
author: Rosalind Halloran
blurb: Mirabel Quintana, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
